title: Spellchecker marks ordinary English words as misspelled after opening a second window
body:
### Electron Version

42.2.0

### What operating system(s) are you using?

macOS

### Operating System Version

macOS 14.7

### Expected Behavior

Both editor windows accept the same standard English dictionary words.

### Actual Behavior

The second editor underlines hello and world, although the first window accepts them. The configuration is:

```js
const webPreferences = {
  spellcheck: true,
  contextIsolation: true,
  sandbox: true
};
```

### Testcase Gist URL

_No response_

### Additional Information

The editor markup and the code that creates the two windows are omitted. No dictionary file or test project is attached.
